summary_short.zh: Odoo是一套开源ERP与商业应用套件，通过单一平台统一管理销售、库存、财务、人力资源等核心业务流程。其模块化架构允许用户仅安装所需应用（如CRM、电商、会计），按需扩展，避免系统臃肿。技术层面，Odoo采用Python开发，支持前后端高度定制，内置强大工作流引擎和报表工具。部署方式灵活，可本地运行或使用云服务。对中小企业而言，Odoo提供低成本、渐进式实施的数字化管理方案，是替代昂贵商业ERP的理想选择。

summaries.en: Odoo is an open-source ERP and business application suite that helps companies manage sales, inventory, accounting, HR, and more from a single platform. Its modular architecture lets you start with one app and add others as needed, avoiding the bloat of traditional ERP systems. You can deploy it on-premise or in the cloud, customize modules via Python, and integrate with third-party tools through its API. Ideal for SMEs seeking an affordable, scalable business management solution.

summary_short.zh: nn-zero-to-hero 是 Andrej Karpathy 推出的神经网络实战课程，以 Jupyter Notebook 为载体，通过 Python 代码逐步实现反向传播、神经网络和 Transformer 等核心概念。课程强调数学直觉与代码实现紧密结合，帮助学习者深入理解模型底层原理。内容从线性模型到完整语言模型循序渐进，每环节配有可运行代码示例，适合希望扎实掌握深度学习基础的研究者或工程师。

summaries.en: nn-zero-to-hero is a hands-on course by Andrej Karpathy that teaches neural networks from scratch using Python and Jupyter notebooks. It demystifies deep learning by building backpropagation, neural networks, and transformers step by step, emphasizing mathematical intuition and code implementation. Ideal for learners who want to truly understand how models work under the hood, the course provides practical exercises to build and train your own networks, making advanced concepts accessible.

summary_short.zh: cfnew是一个轻量级框架，旨在用最少的代码构建和部署自定义AI模型。它采用模块化架构，将模型定义、训练和推理分离，支持快速原型开发。核心设计理念是通过配置文件定义模型结构，大幅减少样板代码。你可以用它快速尝试不同的神经网络设计，或通过单条命令将模型部署到生产环境。适合需要快速迭代实验的AI开发者，尤其适合从研究到落地的过渡阶段。

summaries.en: cfnew is a lightweight framework for building and deploying custom AI models with minimal code. It leverages a modular architecture that separates model definition, training, and inference, enabling rapid prototyping. The key insight is its use of configuration files to define model architectures, reducing boilerplate. You can use it to quickly experiment with different neural network designs or deploy models to production with a single command.
